I appreciate you sharing the task description, but I notice the three article headlines you've provided appear to be incomplete or placeholder text rather than actual article titles and content. 

To write an accurate and useful daily digest, I would need:

1. The full headlines from each article
2. A brief summary or the opening paragraphs of each piece
3. Any key details about what each story covers

Could you provide the complete article titles and summaries? Once I have those details, I'll be happy to write a concise 3-6 sentence digest highlighting the most important themes and developments for your busy executive readers.
